title: Watch the wind gauge when Tick slams the Iron Magistrate in our clockwork roguelite
author: BerryBroCreations
selftext:
In our action roguelite Stillheart Descent, clean hits wind Tick’s spring. Stay Overwound and the next hit costs an extra heart. In this fight with the Iron Magistrate, watch the gauge when Tick spends wind on a ground slam.



We used AutoSprite for Tick’s combat and movement sheets. Entering and leaving Overwound use separate animations in Godot. The tricky part is that your eyes are usually on the boss, so for this clip we put a close-up of the actual gauge under the fight. When you play a roguelite, what do you notice first when a power-up becomes dangerous: the character, the sound, or the HUD?



The full Windows campaign is paid.
